mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 enzymes and has antiplatelet properties, potentially increasing escitalopram levels and bleeding risk, while escitalopram itself increases bleeding risk through platelet inhibition.
action: Monitor for increased escitalopram side effects and bleeding signs; counsel patient on bleeding precautions and consider alternative herbal supplements if high-dose turmeric is used chronically.
